diagrams.title: This week
diagrams.blurb: Ship the SKU cache behind a flag. Receipt PDF is parked. Priya covers 504s until the flag is on.
diagrams.source:
flowchart TB
  P504["Checkout 504s when inventory is cold"]
  CACHE["2s cache in front of SKU lookup"]
  FLAG["Ship behind CHECKOUT_SKU_CACHE"]
  ROLL["Rollback = flip the flag"]
  ONCALL["Priya on-call for 504s"]
  METRICS["Sam owns cache metrics"]
  PDF["Receipt PDF — parked"]

  P504 --> CACHE --> FLAG
  FLAG --> ROLL
  FLAG --> ONCALL
  FLAG --> METRICS
  P504 -.-> PDF

diagrams.title: Who owns what
diagrams.blurb: Sam lands the cache. Priya holds the pager until the flag is on, then Sam takes metrics.
diagrams.source:
sequenceDiagram
  participant A as Alex
  participant S as Sam
  participant P as Priya
  A->>S: cache still in review?
  S-->>A: merges today, flag CHECKOUT_SKU_CACHE
  A->>P: cover 504s until flag is on
  P-->>A: acknowledged
  S->>S: own cache metrics after ship
